lines.en: Fifty-two cards. Four seats. Thirteen each.
lines.zh: 五十二张牌，四个座位，每人十三张。

lines.en: Big Two. Diamonds, clubs, hearts, spades.
lines.zh: 大老二。方块、梅花、红桃、黑桃。

lines.en: The holder of 3♦ leads, and the first play must include it.
lines.zh: 持有 ♦3 的玩家先出，首手必须带上它。

lines.en: Singles, pairs, triples, and five-card poker hands.
lines.zh: 单张、对子、三张，还有五张牌型。

lines.en: Straights, flushes, full houses, four plus one, straight flushes.
lines.zh: 顺子、同花、葫芦、四带一、同花顺。

lines.en: First to empty their hand wins. Every card left scores.
lines.zh: 最先出完手牌的人获胜，剩下的牌要算分。

lines.en: Four computer levels, hot-seat, and a private LAN table.
lines.zh: 四档电脑对手、同屏热座，还有私密局域网牌桌。
